lines: 2025 年 1 月，DeepSeek 发布了 R1。
In January 2025, DeepSeek released R1.
论文里有个实验，几乎不教模型怎么推理。
One experiment in the paper barely teaches reasoning at all.
只给两种奖励：答案对不对，格式合不合规。
Only two rewards: is the answer right, is the format valid.
结果它自己学会了长篇思考、检查、回头重算。
It taught itself long thinking, checking and rewinding.
这一章要问：推理能力能不能被奖励逼出来。
This chapter asks: can rewards force reasoning to appear?
以及它要付出什么代价，边界又卡在哪里。
And what it costs, and where it stops working.
第 8 章的 RLHF，用学出来的奖励模型打分。
Chapter 8's RLHF scored outputs with a learned reward model.
奖励模型自己会错，也会被模型钻空子。
That model makes mistakes, and the policy learns to game it.
可如果题目本身有标准答案，就不需要它。
But when a task has a known answer, we do not need it.
数学题可以比对答案，代码可以跑单元测试。
Math answers can be compared; code can run unit tests.
这种由确定性程序给出的奖励，叫可验证奖励。
A reward from a deterministic program is a verifiable reward.
用这种奖励做强化学习，就叫 RLVR。
Reinforcement learning with it is called RLVR.
信号稀疏但可靠：答对给一，答错给零，没有中间地带。
Sparse but reliable: one for right, zero for wrong, no middle.
为什么推理能力，最先在数学和代码上突破？
Why did reasoning break through in math and code first?
不是这两件事更高级，而是它们更容易自动打分。
Not because they are nobler, but because they grade themselves.
人类教育也一样：练习册能自学，作文要找老师。
Same in school: workbooks self-check, essays need a teacher.
验证器像一把卡尺，只量长度，不夸你聪明。
A verifier is a caliper: it measures length, it does not flatter.
所以它给出的分数，不会被一段漂亮话骗过去。
So its score cannot be talked up by a confident paragraph.
奖励可以很简单，简单到只剩下对和错。
The reward can be simple, simple enough to be right or wrong.
R1-Zero 的实验，大胆到有点不讲道理：什么都不教。
The R1-Zero experiment was bold to the point of being reckless.
拿一个没做过任何监督微调的基座模型。
Take a base model that never had any supervised fine-tuning.
直接上强化学习，只保留两条最简单的奖励。
Put it straight into reinforcement learning with two rewards.
一条看答案对不对，一条看格式合不合规。
One checks the answer, one checks the format.
不告诉它要一步步想，也不给任何推理范例。
Never say think step by step, never show a worked example.
连一句提示都没有，只等它自己把答案算对。
Not even a hint; it just waits for the model to get answers right.
这是把教推理，换成了奖励推理的结果。
Teaching reasoning was replaced by rewarding its result.
训练一开始，它的回答只有几百个 token。
At the start, its answers were only a few hundred tokens long.
后来涨到几千个，而且训练中还在继续变长。
Later they grew to several thousand, and kept growing.
它开始自己检查、回头改、换一种解法重新试一遍。
It began to check itself, go back, and retry with another method.
论文记下某个时刻：它停下来说，等等，让我重新想想。
The paper records a moment: it stops and says, wait, let me rethink.
论文把这个瞬间，叫作模型的顿悟时刻。
The paper calls this instant the model's aha moment.
AIME 2024 上，基座约 15.6%，Zero 到 71.0%。
On AIME 2024, the base sat near 15.6%; Zero reached 71.0%.
正式版 R1 是 79.8%，多数投票能到 86.7%。
The full R1 reached 79.8%, and 86.7% with majority voting.
RLHF 常用 PPO，PPO 需要一个价值网络当评论家。
RLHF usually uses PPO, and PPO needs a value network as critic.
评论家和策略模型一样大，显存开销几乎直接翻倍。
That critic is as large as the policy, so memory roughly doubles.
GRPO 说：不要评论家，看同一组答案里的排名。
GRPO says: drop the critic, rank answers inside one group.
同一个问题采样八个答案，用组内的相对排名算优势。
Sample eight answers to one question, then measure relative advantage.
减去组内均值，再除以标准差，就是优势。
Subtract the group mean, divide by the standard deviation.
减去均值不改变梯度的期望，却能把方差大幅降低。
Subtracting the mean keeps the gradient unbiased and cuts variance.
全对或全错时，优势全零；题目要略高于模型水平。
All right or all wrong means zero advantage; match the difficulty.
这和教育学里的最近发展区，是同一个道理。
This is the zone of proximal development, in another guise.
R1-Zero 有两个毛病：中英混杂，可读性差。
R1-Zero had two flaws: mixed languages and poor readability.
所以正式版 R1 没有直接用它，加了四个阶段。
So the released R1 did not use it directly, but added four stages.
第一阶段冷启动：几千条长思维链，先教格式。
Stage one, cold start: a few thousand long chains, teaching format.
第二阶段推理 RL：还是准确性和格式奖励。
Stage two, reasoning RL: the same accuracy and format rewards.
第三阶段拒绝采样：只留验证器判对的答案，再做微调。
Stage three, rejection sampling: keep verified answers, then fine-tune.
第四阶段全场景 RL：加上有用、无害这些通用奖励。
Stage four, general RL: add helpfulness and harmlessness rewards.
冷启动不是教推理，是给 RL 一个稳定的起点。
Cold start does not teach reasoning; it gives RL a stable start.
拒绝采样，本质是让模型用自己的成功案例来教自己。
Rejection sampling lets the model teach itself with its own successes.
这也叫自我蒸馏：先大量采样，再由验证器筛选，最后保留。
This is self-distillation: sample widely, filter hard, keep the winners.
为什么不直接用 Zero？因为它虽然强，但不好用。
Why not use Zero directly? Because it is strong but hard to ship.
语言混杂、格式散乱，产品里没法直接交付。
Mixed languages and messy format cannot be delivered as a product.
冷启动补上格式，拒绝采样补上数据，RL 补上能力。
Cold start fixes format, rejection sampling fixes data, RL fixes ability.
四步走完，能力才变成可以交付的产品。
After four stages, ability becomes something you can ship.
R1 的论文里，还有一个反直觉的发现。
The R1 paper reports one more counterintuitive finding.
让小模型直接做 RLVR，效果远不如蒸馏大模型的轨迹。
Direct RLVR on a small model works far worse than distillation.
做法是用 R1 生成大量带推理过程的答案。
The recipe: let R1 generate many answers with reasoning traces.
拿这些轨迹去微调 Qwen、Llama 这些小模型。
Then fine-tune small Qwen and Llama models on those traces.
得到的 R1-Distill，从 15 亿到 700 亿参数。
The R1-Distill family runs from 1.5B to 70B parameters.
在数学基准上，它们远超同尺寸的原始模型。
On math benchmarks they far outperform same-size originals.
蒸馏是把想的过程当成知识来复制，RL 是让它自己试。
Distillation copies the process; RL makes the model discover it.
很多人把那个顿悟时刻，读成一个突然觉醒的故事。
Many people read that aha moment as a story of sudden awakening.
但机制上，它仍然是奖励塑造出来的长期累积。
But mechanically it is still long accumulation shaped by reward.
桑代克在 1911 年就说过：好结果会强化行为。
Thorndike said it in 1911: behavior with good results gets reinforced.
苛勒研究的顿悟，看起来很像，但不是同一回事。
Kohler's chimpanzee insight looks alike but is not the same thing.
它看起来像顿悟，但不等于它不是试错。
Looking like insight does not mean it is not trial and error.
奖励设计与规模，才是这件事的两个前提。
Reward design and scale are the two real preconditions.
RLVR 有一条很硬的边界：只在能验证的地方有效。
RLVR has a hard boundary: it works only where you can verify.
写小说、做战略、安慰朋友，都没有自动验证器。
Novels, strategy, comforting a friend: no automatic verifier.
验证器本身也会被 hack：奖励只看格式，模型就只做格式。
The verifier can be hacked: check format only, get format only.
如果测试用例太少，模型就会过拟合这套测试。
Too few test cases, and the model overfits the tests.
还有长度膨胀：写得越长，越容易碰对答案。
Then length inflation: write longer, hit the answer by luck.
过度优化数学，可能损害通用对话，这叫对齐税。
Over-optimizing math can hurt general chat; that is the alignment tax.
还有可读性下降：纯 RL 的推理，人可能看不懂。
Then readability: pure-RL reasoning may be unreadable to us.
古德哈特定律说：一个指标一旦成为目标，就不再是好指标。
Goodhart's law: once a metric becomes a target, it stops being good.
把第 9 章和第 10 章放在一起看，有三条路线。
Put chapters 9 and 10 together, and three routes appear.
第一条是提示：在输入里要求它一步步想，成本最低。
Route one, prompting: ask it in the input to think step by step.
第二条是搜索：采样多条、投票、做树搜索，花推理算力。
Route two, search: sample many, vote, or run tree search.
第三条是训练：用 RL 把推理策略写进权重。
Route three, training: write the reasoning policy into the weights.
训练贵在前，搜索贵在后；训练定下限，搜索定上限。
Training pays up front, search pays per use: one floor, one ceiling.
三者可以叠加，不是非此即彼的替代关系。
The three stack; they do not replace each other.
这一章的主线，其实是一次奖励的替换。
The throughline of this chapter is a single swap of reward.
从人类觉得好，换成答案可验证地正确。
From humans liking it, to answers being verifiably right.
R1-Zero 证明它有效，GRPO 让它更便宜。
R1-Zero proved it works; GRPO made it cheaper.
配方和蒸馏，把它变成可以交付的产品。
The pipeline and distillation made it shippable.
但推理模型很贵：6710 亿参数，每次都要全激活吗？
But reasoning models are costly: must all 671B parameters fire?
下一章讲效率：MoE、注意力压缩、线性架构。
Next: efficiency, MoE, attention compression, linear architectures.
